s: the roadside biscuit legend at the foot of the Natchez Trace
w: A former 1950s motor court turned Southern breakfast institution at the start of the Natchez Trace Parkway, famous above all for its biscuits and preserves -- the kind of stop that's built a national reputation on doing one thing, simply, better than almost anyone. Country ham, fried chicken and the same recipes since it opened keep locals coming back alongside the tour buses.
_facts: Located at 8400 Tennessee 100, Nashville, TN 37221, Bellevue, at the northern terminus of the Natchez Trace Parkway
Opened in 1951 as a motor court and restaurant
Best known nationally for its biscuits and preserves
Also serves Southern breakfast and country ham, fried chicken
